item.title: Homes With A View: Top 2025 Sales Go for $17.1M to $42M
item.description: A review of the county’s 25 most expensive residential transactions in 2025, ranging from about $17.15 million to $42 million, shows the top deals clustered along the coastlines of Newport Coast, Corona del Mar, Dana Point and Laguna Beach. item.description: LoanDepot has started a new wholesale lending channel that aims to offer mortgage brokers a “white-glove, relationship-first experience” with competitive pricing.
